about_us_heading.title: Turning every mile into a smile
about_us_heading.paragraph: Walks in Town was founded on a simple idea: the best way to know a city is to walk it with someone who truly loves it. We're a team of local guides, storytellers, and city lovers on a mission to make every traveler feel like they belong.

content_photo.title: Started with one walk through Florence at sunrise
paragraphs: Walks in Town began in 2021, when our founder started leading small morning walks for friends visiting Florence — no scripts, no big crowds, just honest local stories and the best views before the tour buses arrived.

Word spread fast. Travelers kept asking for the same thing: less rushing, more meaning. So we built a team of local guides who share that same love for their city, and turned those early-morning walks into what Walks in Town is today.
content_photo.blue_paragraph: Real people. Real places. Real stories.

content_photo_our_mission.title: To help travelers experience each city like a local
paragraphs: Our mission is to make every journey more personal, meaningful, and memorable. We connect travelers with passionate local guides who bring each destination to life through authentic stories, hidden places, and genuine cultural experiences.
We believe the best way to discover a city is not simply to see its landmarks, but to understand the people, traditions, and moments that make it unique.
content_photo_our_mission.blue_paragraph: Walk deeper. Discover more. Feel at home.
